name: Shimizu Corporation
summary: Shimizu Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction, development, engineering, and life cycle valuation businesses in Japan and internationally. The company plans, designs, builds, repairs, manages, operates, and maintains offices, plants, schools, hospitals, and other buildings; designs, builds, and renovates tunnels, bridges, dams, urban infrastructure, and energy facilities and other public works; provides construction for manufacturing facilities, high-rise buildings, hospitals, bridges, subways, and other projects; and develops and rents real estate properties.
